about.p1: is a Croatia-based timber trading and import-export company established in 2012, specializing in European hardwood and softwood for international markets.
about.p2: With extensive knowledge of the European timber industry and international trade, we are committed to supplying quality European wood products to customers across the Middle East, Gulf countries, and Egypt.
about.p3: Over the years, we have developed our business through professional relationships, market knowledge, and a commitment to reliable service. We understand the importance of quality, consistency, and trust in international timber trading, and we work to build every business relationship on these principles.
about.p4: Our commitment goes beyond delivering products. We work to understand our customers' needs, maintain high standards, and improve our services as the markets we serve evolve.
about.badgeText: Specialized in European hardwood and softwood for international markets since 2012.

award.title: Prestigious "Golden Key" (Zlatni Ključ) Export Award
award.text1: In 2016, MIDO IMPORT-EXPORT d.o.o. was honored with the prestigious "Golden Key" (Zlatni Ključ) award by the Croatian Exporters Association, nominated in the Africa category and awarded as the Best Exporter to Egypt in 2015.
award.text2: This milestone reflects our strong export performance, deep international trade connections, and unwavering commitment to supply reliability.

mission.label: OUR MISSION
mission.title: Driven by excellence, integrity, and lasting partnerships.
mission.text: We provide dependable timber sourcing and supply solutions, supported by professional service, market expertise, and a clear understanding of customer requirements. We work to maintain transparency, efficiency, and consistency while creating value for our customers and business partners.

vision.label: OUR VISION
vision.title: Committed to progress, innovation, and responsible growth.
vision.text: We aim to expand the global reach of European timber, reach new markets, and make our products accessible to customers worldwide. We aspire to be a trusted international timber trading partner, connecting European wood resources with global demand through quality, reliability, and long-term partnerships.

products.title: European Beech Wood Portfolio
products.subtitle: Our product portfolio includes a wide range of European hardwood and softwood species, carefully sourced to serve the needs of international markets. We provide timber solutions for various commercial, industrial, and manufacturing applications.

items.title: Steamed Unedged Beech Wood
items.applications: Rich warm tone preferred for solid hardwood furniture, architectural joinery, and staircases.

items.title: Unsteamed Unedged Beech
items.applications: Natural light cream European beech grain, selected for custom interior finishes and contemporary cabinetry.
